about: The ready apps a new organisation can release in its first minute (IC-958 addendum): real apps built on store.org, the bundles in /orgs/starters/. The page reads this list as it is; each entry needs id, name, says (one line), can (what it can do, in plain words), why (the one line that says what only Krate does), bundle, shot (a picture of the app in use, from its real-hub test) top (its three best things, a few words each) and category (Everyday, Operations, People or Finance: the chips the picker shows once there are more than six).

starters.name: Team Notes
starters.says: Notes your whole team shares, saved as you type.
can: Write and edit notes anyone in the team can open
Search every note
Pin the ones that matter to the top
See who changed each note last, and when
Bring back a deleted note with Undo
Keep working offline; it catches up by itself
starters.why: Encrypted end to end: not even Krate can read your team's notes.

starters.name: Requests
starters.says: Ask for something and get a clear yes or no, with a note.
can: Ask for a purchase, access, time or a change, and name who approves it
See what is waiting for you to decide
Approve or decline with a note the asker reads
Withdraw a request, or ask again after a no
See who asked, who decided and what they said
starters.why: Encrypted end to end: not even Krate can read your team's requests.

starters.name: Help Desk
starters.says: Tickets for what breaks, who has each one, and the comments.
can: File a ticket with how urgent it is
Take a ticket, or name who should look at it
Comment on a ticket; everyone sees the thread
Mark it waiting on a reply, solved, or reopen it
See what is open by urgency and who has what
starters.why: Encrypted end to end: not even Krate can read your team's tickets.

starters.name: Contacts
starters.says: The companies you work with, the people there, and the next step.
can: Add a company and the people there
Log each call or meeting with the next step
See which next steps are due or overdue
Mark a next step done
Keep where you are with each: lead, talking, customer
starters.why: Encrypted end to end: not even Krate can read your team's contacts.

starters.name: Stock List
starters.says: Keep count of what the team has and what is running low.
can: Add items with how many there are
Count things in and out with + and -
Set when each item counts as running low
See only what is running low
Set the count after a stocktake
Two people counting at once both count
starters.why: Encrypted end to end: not even Krate can see what your team keeps.

starters.name: Assets
starters.says: Know who has which laptop, phone or tool, and its history.
can: List equipment with its serial number
Hand a thing to someone, or back into store
Send it for repair and mark it back
Retire what is gone
See every hand-over with who did it and when
starters.why: Encrypted end to end: not even Krate can see what your team owns.

starters.name: Inspections
starters.says: Run the same checklist the same way, and see what failed.
can: Start from fire safety, vehicle or opening-up checklists
Make your own checklist, one item per line
Pass or fail each item, with a note
Finish an inspection once every item is checked
See what failed and still needs fixing
starters.why: Encrypted end to end: not even Krate can read your team's inspections.

starters.name: Visitors
starters.says: Sign visitors in and out, and see who is on site now.
can: Sign a visitor in with who they came to see
Note the badge they hold and why they came
Sign them out with one press
See who is on site right now
Look back at every visit, day by day
starters.why: Encrypted end to end: not even Krate can see who visits your team.

starters.name: Incidents
starters.says: Log what went wrong, act on it, and close it.
can: Report an incident with how bad it was
Add actions with an owner and a day
Tick actions off as they are done
Close it, or reopen it
See what is open, worst first
starters.why: Encrypted end to end: not even Krate can read your team's incidents.

starters.name: Leave
starters.says: Book days off, see who is away, and the days left.
can: Book holiday, sick days or training
See the week: who is away each day
See how many days of holiday each person has left
Set the team's yearly allowance
Two bookings that overlap are caught
starters.why: Encrypted end to end: not even Krate can see when your team is away.

starters.name: Onboarding
starters.says: A checklist for every new joiner, with owners and days.
can: Add a new joiner and get the usual eight tasks
Each task has an owner and a day it is due
Tick tasks off; see how far along each person is
Add, change or remove tasks
See what is yours to do and what is late
starters.why: Encrypted end to end: not even Krate can read your team's onboarding.

starters.name: Shift Rota
starters.says: The week's shifts per person, and swaps.
can: See the week: a row per person, a column per day
Add early, day, late or night shifts
Ask for a swap with a reason
Take a shift someone wants to swap
See each person's hours for the week
starters.why: Encrypted end to end: not even Krate can see your team's rota.

starters.name: Timesheets
starters.says: Log hours per project per day, with the week's totals.
can: Log hours against a project on a day
See the week as a table: projects by days, with totals
See one person's week or the whole team's
Totals by person and by project
A day over 24 hours is caught
starters.why: Encrypted end to end: not even Krate can see your team's hours.

starters.name: Expenses
starters.says: Log what the team spends and see who is owed what.
can: Log an amount, currency, what it was for, the day and a receipt note
See what each person is owed, per currency
See what each month cost
Mark an expense paid back, or undo it
Fix a mistake or delete an expense, with Undo
starters.why: Encrypted end to end: not even Krate can see your team's spending.

starters.name: Purchase Orders
starters.says: Ask to buy, get it approved, and mark it received.
can: Ask to buy something, from a supplier, for an amount
The person you name approves or declines with a note
Mark an order ordered, then received
See what waits for approval and what was approved this month
Totals per currency and per supplier
starters.why: Encrypted end to end: not even Krate can see what your team buys.
